text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Gagh, dang! I forgot all about our
homework!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh my, is everything all right?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
This is it... It's do or die! Grass, I need a
favor—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You know I can't let you copy my
homework, El...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There's no point to homework if you
don't do it
yourself...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you can do it if you try. I'll be
cheering
you on!
